$comment: Single source of truth for this fork's identity. Everything else is derived by branding/apply.mjs; never hand-edit a branded string in the tree.
$comment_article: The indefinite article has to agree with the sound the name starts with. Upstream's name is vowel-initial and this fork's is not, so a plain substitution would leave 'an BlackMushi' behind.
$comment_protected: Substrings that must survive untouched: they are identifiers, not copy. Renaming any of them changes deep-link routing, bundle identity or on-disk data location, which would orphan existing installs.
$comment_exclude: Paths the overlay never rewrites. The changelog records what upstream actually shipped under its own name, and a shipped migration is an immutable artefact -- rewriting either would make it lie, and an edited migration can read as drift even when only a comment moved. Lockfiles are generated. Files named LICENSE/NOTICE are additionally protected in apply.mjs.
